name: London to Walsingham
description_md:
The London to Walsingham is a waymarked hiking route in GB. This trail covers 269.0 km and includes 1785 m of ascent and 1791 m of descent.

The route is signposted as LW and belongs to a regional waymarked hiking network. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 72 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes the Tower of London within 100 m and the Millennium Bridge within 900 m.
